forbidden.comment: An npm import missing from package.json works only by accident of hoisting.
forbidden.fix: Add the package to dependencies (or devDependencies for test and build code) of the nearest package.json.
forbidden.name: no-non-package-json

forbidden.comment: A deprecated Node built-in will be removed.
forbidden.fix: Replace the module: punycode with the url API, domain with async hooks or try/catch, constants with os.constants or fs.constants, sys with util.
forbidden.name: no-deprecated-core

forbidden.comment: A package listed in more than one dependencies section installs unpredictably.
forbidden.fix: Keep the package in exactly one section of package.json: dependencies for run-time code, devDependencies otherwise.
forbidden.name: no-duplicate-dep-types

forbidden.comment: A module nothing imports and that imports nothing is usually dead code.
forbidden.fix: Delete the module, import it from where it belongs, or add its path to this rule's from.pathNot if it is an entry point or a configuration file.
forbidden.name: no-orphans
